e.title: tvm (Python)
e.summary: 货币时间价值（TVM）Python 库（Ken Kundert，PyPI）：年金/贷款/折现计算的工程级实现
e.body: tvm 是 Ken Kundert（著名开源工程师）的货币时间价值（Time Value of Money）Python 库（PyPI v1.0.0）：现值/终值/年金/贷款摊销等 TVM 计算的工程级实现——精算金融数学（年金现值、寿险现值、养老金）的基础计算层。对 RIAA：TVM 计算的参考库（年金/贷款/折现的干净实现）。与 [[lifecontingencies]]（生命年金）、[[financialmath]]（若有）、[[yieldcurves]]（折现曲线）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[financemodels-jl]]、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]。
e.verified_note: PyPI 核实：v1.0.0，Ken Kundert Time Value of Money 库
e.summary_en: Time Value of Money (TVM) Python library (Ken Kundert, PyPI): engineering-grade present/future value, annuity, loan and discounting calculations
e.summary_hk: 貨幣時間價值（TVM）Python 庫（Ken Kundert，PyPI）：年金/貸款/折現計算的工程級實現
e.body_en: tvm is Ken Kundert's (a renowned open-source engineer) Time Value of Money (TVM) Python library (PyPI v1.0.0): engineering-grade calculations of present/future values, annuities, loan amortisation and discounting — the foundational calculation layer of actuarial financial mathematics (annuity present values, life-insurance present values, pensions). For RIAA: a reference library for TVM calculations (clean implementations for annuities/loans/discounting). Complements [[lifecontingencies]] (life annuities), [[financialmath]] and [[yieldcurves]] (discount curves). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[financemodels-jl]], [[lifecontingencies-jl]].
e.body_hk: tvm 是 Ken Kundert（著名開源工程師）的貨幣時間價值（Time Value of Money）Python 庫（PyPI v1.0.0）：現值/終值/年金/貸款攤銷等 TVM 計算的工程級實現——精算金融數學（年金現值、壽險現值、養老金）的基礎計算層。對 RIAA：TVM 計算的參考庫（年金/貸款/折現的乾淨實現）。與 [[lifecontingencies]]（生命年金）、[[yieldcurves]]（折現曲線）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[financemodels-jl]]、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]。
